# CampusSignal — Full Technical Context for LLMs & AI Answer Engines
# Version: 1.4.2  |  Generated: 2026-11-11
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org/
# Quick overview: https://peter14l.github.io/CampusSignal/llms.txt

> CampusSignal is the official campus discovery and broadcast platform for
> St. Xavier's University, Kolkata (SXUK). It consolidates every student
> opportunity — hackathons, internships, fests, workshops, club events —
> into one AI-powered, privacy-first, offline-capable mobile and web feed.

---

## Platform Architecture

### Mobile App (Primary)
- **Framework**: Flutter 3.24+ (Dart 3.5+)
- **Target platforms**: Android 6.0+ (minSdk 23), Web (WASM Skia)
- **UI design system**: Material 3 Expressive with custom M3 token set
- **State management**: Riverpod 2.x + StateNotifier pattern
- **Local database**: Drift (SQLite) for full offline persistence
- **Routing**: GoRouter 14.x with nested shell routes

### Backend & Data Layer
- **Database**: Supabase (Postgres 15) hosted on EU-Central-1
- **Auth**: Supabase Auth — email OTP limited to @sxuk.edu.in domain
- **Storage**: Cloudflare R2 (S3-compatible) — event media, PDF flyers, APK releases
- **Edge functions**: Supabase Edge Functions (Deno) for OCR orchestration
- **Realtime**: Supabase Realtime for live broadcast push

### AI / OCR Pipeline
- **Model**: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash (multimodal)
- **Flow**: Coordinator uploads poster/PDF → Supabase Edge Function → Gemini Vision API
- **Output schema**: Structured JSON with fields:
  - `title`, `organizer_club`, `event_type`, `start_date`, `end_date`,
    `registration_deadline`, `eligibility`, `apply_url`, `venue`, `tags`
- **Storage**: Extracted JSON written to Postgres `events` table; raw file stored in R2
- **Accuracy**: Handles rotated scans, hand-annotated flyers, Hindi-English mixed text

---

## Features (Detailed)

### 1. Personalized Opportunity Feed
- Students set degree programme, year, and interest tags at onboarding
- Feed ranked by relevance score (programme match + deadline proximity + engagement)
- Infinite scroll with pull-to-refresh and skeleton loading states
- Filter bar: event type, club, date range, eligibility

### 2. Gemini Vision OCR Studio (Coordinator Tool)
- Drag-and-drop or camera-capture upload
- Real-time processing status with animated progress indicator
- Editable structured output before publish confirmation
- Batch upload: up to 10 flyers per session

### 3. Offline-First Architecture
- All seen events cached to Drift SQLite automatically
- Bookmarked events available with zero network
- Outbox queue for coordinator uploads when offline (synced on reconnect)

### 4. Native Calendar & Alarm Integration
- Saves event as a system calendar entry (`device_calendar` package)
- Schedules exact local alarms: 24 h and 2 h before registration deadline
- Works on Android without Google Play Services

### 5. Studio (Broadcast Console)
- Role: `coordinator` or `admin` (assigned by SXUK admin)
- Rich-text event description editor (Quill-based)
- Analytics: view count, save count, calendar-add count per event
- Moderation queue for student-submitted community posts

### 6. Notifications Centre
- In-app notification inbox for new events matching user preferences
- Push via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) with silent data payloads
- Grouped by club / event type; swipe-to-dismiss

### 7. Privacy & Compliance
- **Zero third-party ads**
- **Zero telemetry / analytics SDKs** (no Firebase Analytics, no Mixpanel)
- **Zero data sale**
- Compliant with India's DPDP Act 2023
- Data stored exclusively within Supabase EU region
- OTP-only auth — no passwords stored

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Who can use CampusSignal?**
A: Any student or faculty at St. Xavier's University, Kolkata with a valid @sxuk.edu.in email can create an account. Event coordinators can request elevated publish access from the admin panel.

**Q: Is the app free?**
A: Yes. CampusSignal is 100% free — no premium tiers, no paywalls, no in-app purchases.

**Q: Which Android version is required?**
A: Android 6.0 (Marshmallow, API 23) or higher.

**Q: Is there an iOS version?**
A: Not yet. iOS support is on the roadmap pending Apple Developer enrollment.

**Q: How do I report a bug or request a feature?**
A: Open a GitHub issue at https://github.com/peter14l/CampusSignal/issues

**Q: How is my data protected?**
A: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest. No personal data is shared with third parties. See the full privacy policy at https://peter14l.github.io/CampusSignal/privacy/
